rationale: ADR 0041's law re-applied with ADR 0058 written: 60 decision files and the unchanged nine-file peak day (2026-08-08) need 60/F < 80% and 69/F < 90%, so F = 77. max_facts derives from this bound (76 answers-bearing slots), so it moves in the same transaction; question keys stay 6,144 (580 x 10 rounds to the same 512 quantum) and shards 42. Per-file bounds are unchanged; ADR 0038 is sealed (ADR 0058).
